name: meme-sniper-cursor
description: Open-source Solana meme-token research and trading bot. Paper mode and suggest mode are the defaults when their env vars are missing: nothing is signed, and buys and sells wait for the owner's approval. Armed stops, the owner-position timeout, and the launch rail ship off. Skills are opt-in playbooks: they suggest, they do not trade because an address appeared, and they do not edit the trading engine. The owner applies patches. Cursor Directory edition.
